Name: (BFAV) Additional Dinosaurs - Unofficial Conversion of Rurat's Dinosaurs
Author: Lomeki
Description:
[size=4][b]Details:
[/b][/size][size=2]
[/size][size=2]This mod uses the raptor, charchar, and stego assets from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2215/]Rurat's Dinosaurs[/url], by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3616750]The Saboratory[/url]. I merely modified their assets to create different colors. In total there are 8 additional dinosaurs.

The colors in this mod include:

[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Purple Raptor[/size]
[*][size=2]Pink Raptor[/size]
[*][size=2]Red Raptor[/size]
[*][size=2]CharChar[/size]
[*][size=2]Shiny CharChar[/size]
[*][size=2]Purple Stegosaurus[/size]
[*][size=2]Green Stegosaurus[/size]
[*][size=2]Red Stegosaurus[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4]Future Plans:[/size]
[size=2]
[/size][/b][list]
[*]Make the dinosaur available at Marnie's Ranch so you can more easily acquire all varieties.
[*]Test the consequences of removing the vanilla dinosaur.
[*]Let me know if you have any other ideas that I can try to implement!
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation Instructions (v2.0.0):[/b]
[/size]There are no longer any additional steps required to get this mod working! Simply drag and drop it into your mods folder (given you have the latest version of BFAV (3.0.0-unofficial.7-mouseypounds) installed.) 

[size=4][b]Installation Instructions (v1.0.0):[/b][/size]
For version 1.0.0 of this mod, you have to edit the config file from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3296]Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety[/url] mod. See detailed instructions below.

1. The new dinos only appear when the hatchling is set to random. To do this, go into the mod folder for Paritee's Better Farm Animal Variety and open the config.json file. Set "RandomizeHatchlingFromCategory" to true. The line should look like this:

[code]"RandomizeHatchlingFromCategory": true,[/code]

NOTE: This also makes all chicken eggs randomly choose a type of chicken when hatched from the incubator, making it possible to get void chickens from normal eggs and vice versa.


2. Next, to add the dinosaurs into the game, scroll down to the bottom of the same config.json where it says

[code]"Dinosaur": {
      "Types": [
        "Dinosaur",
      ],
[/code]

Change this to:


[code]"Dinosaur": {
"Types": [
  "Dinosaur",
  "Purple Raptor",
  "Pink Raptor",
  "Red Raptor",
  "CharChar",
  "Shiny CharChar",
  "Purple Stegosaurus",
  "Green Stegosaurus",
  "Red Stegosaurus"
],
[/code]
3. You're done! Your dinosaurs will now randomly hatch one of 9 different dinosaurs! (including vanilla)

NOTE: I have reached out to user [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3616750]Digitalsabre/The Saboratory[/url] for official permission to use their assets. I will update this as soon as I get a response.
